requirements.text: Students should be able to search the library catalogue with real-time availability.
Students should be able to borrow, return, and renew items online.
Students should be able to book study rooms online, selecting date, time slot, and room capacity.
Students should have access to their account information to view current loans, due dates, and outstanding fines.
Students should receive automated email reminders before due dates and notifications when fines are applied.
The system should provide a robust tool for managing book inventory, including adding, updating, and retiring items.
The system should generate insightful usage reports on loan volumes, item popularity, and study room utilization.
The system should allow placing holds or restrictions on student accounts based on outstanding fines.
The system should automatically calculate fines for overdue items based on a configurable daily rate.
Students should be able to view their outstanding fines in their account.
The system should automatically send email notifications to students when fines are applied.
Students with outstanding fines exceeding a certain threshold should be automatically blocked from making new loans or room bookings.
The system must seamlessly integrate with the existing student record system for real-time access to student data.
The system must implement strong data protection measures for storing and processing student data.
Students should have the ability to access their data and request corrections.
Clearly defined processes for data retention and deletion must be in place.
Students must be informed about how their data is being used and have the option to consent to data processing.
